definitions.matched-direct: P19 itself is a settlement whose external id matches one place record
definitions.matched-after-walk: P19 is finer than a city; P131 led to one settlement whose external id matches one place record
definitions.dropped-multiple-p19: the player item has more than one place of birth
definitions.dropped-multiple-parents: a finer-than-city level has more than one P131 parent
definitions.dropped-no-parent: a finer-than-city level has no P131 parent
definitions.dropped-coarser: the walk reached a state, country, county or other non-settlement before a matching settlement
definitions.dropped-not-settlement-by-p31: an external id matches a place record but Wikidata does not class the item as a human settlement
definitions.dropped-ambiguous-record: the item's external ids match more than one place record
definitions.dropped-no-external-id-match: a settlement whose external ids match no place record (US: Census Gazetteer places; elsewhere: GeoNames cities500)
definitions.dropped-country-mismatch: the matched place record is in a different country than the item's P17
definitions.dropped-no-label: the settlement has no English or default (mul) label to show
definitions.dropped-no-place-data: Wikidata returned nothing for the place item
definitions.absent-no-wikidata-item: no Wikidata item carries the athlete's league id
definitions.absent-ids-resolve-to-several-items: the athlete's league ids point at more than one Wikidata item
definitions.absent-item-shared-by-several-athletes: one Wikidata item carries the league ids of more than one athlete
definitions.absent-no-p19: the Wikidata item has no place of birth

nbaArenas.method: team item = the NBA team item (P118 Q155223) that at least 3 roster players and 60% of the voting ones were on (dated P54) on Jan 1 of the season; arena = the one dated P115 statement covering Nov 1 of the season's first year; any undated P115 statement leaves it out. A venue that lists the team as occupant (P466) from after every P115 start counts as a move the team item lacks, so the overlap leaves those seasons out (the Clippers' P115 ends open at Crypto.com Arena; Intuit Dome lists them from 2024). The name is the venue's dated English official name (P1448) for the season when there is one, else its current English label
